name: Parastatic
source:
In a vast and expansive galaxy lies Future's Past, a bustling theme park paying homage to the past's idea of what the future could be. However, beyond the jovial themed entertainment and attractions, tensions amongst Future's Past staff are high following the recent disappearance of an employee. 

In the midst of an unsuccessful investigation, park operations resume as normal, and employees Wen, Lacey, and Max prepare to make their latest company shipment.

[From [url=https://taylorsconfused.itch.io/parastatic]itch.io[/url]]
